subject: HelixHealth: private VPC hosting — residency, audit access & credit ask
messages:
From: Alice Morton <alice.morton@helixhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; Tom Becker <t.becker@helixhealth.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 09:03:00 +0200
Subject: Private VPC deployment - residency, audit access, and pricing concession

Hi Karthik —

Thanks again for the demo last week. HelixHealth is very interested in Redwood Private (VPC). A couple of non-standard items are deal breakers for us, so I wanted to put them in writing and see if Redwood can accommodate as part of an 18-month committed purchase. High-level asks: 

- Strict EU-only data residency (logs and backups).
- Quarterly audit windows for our security team to review logs and storage — we do not need SSH, but need timeboxed access to request forensic exports.
- 20–25% credit on committed spend year 1 (we can prepay 50% upfront).

Attached: Helix_SOW_Request.pdf and HelixDataFlow_v2.png (very small diagrams). Would like to know what concessions are possible and whether any of these require Exec/Legal signoff.

Can we lock a quick call today or tomorrow?

Best,
Alice Morton
CISO, HelixHealth Systems

P: +44 20 7946 0011

Quick plan: I can schedule a 30-minute alignment call this afternoon to walk through the SOW diagram with our SEs. Meanwhile I'll escalate the credit + access asks to Marissa (sales lead) and Laura in Legal and pull together the minimal set of documentation they’ll need.

Proposed time: 16:00 CEST today — does that work?

Thanks,

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai; rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:40:00 +0200
Subject: Fwd: HelixHealth - summary & ask for exec review (credit + residency carveouts)

Team — forwarding Helix's request. TL;DR of Helix asks: EU-only residency, quarterly audit windows (read-only exports), and 20–25% credit year one with 18-month commit & 50% prepay. Pricing impact is material (~€1.2M ARR run rate).

Asking Deal Desk / Exec: approval for up to 22% one-time credit in year 1 (applied as prepaid credit against usage), and carveout language that limits audit access to scheduled 8-hour windows with Redwood-provided log exports (no direct host access). Legal should confirm whether we can accept a clause that permits customer-requested forensic exports (timeboxed) and what wording is needed for KMS/keys. 

Attachments: Proposed_Concessions_helix_v1.docx — includes suggested contract language and simple P&L impact.

If this requires additional C-suite approval, please flag (I can route to CFO / CRO).

Marissa Cole
VP, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai; rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai; karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 09:10:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Fwd: HelixHealth - summary & ask for exec review (credit + residency carveouts)

Marissa / team — I reviewed the SOW and proposed concessions. High-level legal risks and recommended mitigations: 

1) Audit access: we cannot permit any customer SSH or host-level access. We can commit to scheduled forensic exports (redacted as needed) and provide read-only log bundles. Propose language: "Redwood will provide scheduled, timeboxed forensic exports and log packages; direct administrative access to Redwood-managed hosts is not permitted."

2) Data residency: EU-only hosting is acceptable if Helix agrees to a documented exception process for emergency egress (with notice and approval). Add clause for cross-border egress only under incident response and per documented approvals.

3) KMS: we can offer customer-managed keys for encryption at rest only if Helix uses supported KMS integrations; keys cannot be escrowed to customer control in our hosted infrastructure. For Private/VPC on-prem we can discuss key escrow for air-gapped installs, but that triggers higher operational costs.

4) Credit: a 22% upfront/prepaid credit is a commercial concession. Legal OK on condition that credit is non-refundable and applied only to service charges within the committed term; include recapture if contract terminates early. Finance must sign off on P&L impact.

I'm attaching Legal_redlines_Helix.docx with suggested contract edits and a short risk note. If Sales wants to proceed, we need an approval email from an Exec owner (Marissa or CRO) confirming the commercial cap and the non-negotiable legal mitigations above.

Laura Bennett
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Alice Morton <alice.morton@helixhealth.com>; Tom Becker <t.becker@helixhealth.com>; procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai; laura_bennett@redwood.ai; rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:05:00 +0200
Subject: RE: HelixHealth: private VPC hosting — residency, audit access & credit ask

Alice / Tom — thank you for the patience while we reviewed this internally. Redwood can agree to the Helix asks with the following executive-approved conditions: 

1) Residency: EU-only hosting will be enforced for production datasets and backups. Emergency cross-border egress requires documented approval from Helix security and Redwood (incident triggers only).

2) Audit access: we will provide quarterly scheduled audit windows (8 hours) where Redwood will deliver read-only log bundles and timeboxed forensic exports. No direct host/SSH access will be granted. Redwood will provide a documented export format and an on-call SE to support the window.

3) KMS: For this VPC deployment we will support Helix-managed keys via supported KMS integrations. Key escrow or HSM handover is not included in the standard Private package and would be scoped separately.

4) Commercial concession: Executive approval for a one-time 22% credit applied against Year 1 charges, conditional on an 18-month committed term and a 50% prepayment at signing. Credit is non-refundable and subject to recapture for early termination per the SOW.

Next steps: I have uploaded the redlined SOW to HubSpot and initiated a DocuSign envelope for the revised MSA + SOW (link below). Please review the redlines from Legal (attached) and confirm acceptance so we can send the DocuSign.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/contract/XYZ12345
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

If Helix accepts these terms, Karh will coordinate signature and a kick-off technical call.

Regards,
Marissa Cole
VP, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
